visualCharacteristics: A grid of clickable product tiles, each with an icon, a linked title and a short description, followed by a call-to-action button. The icons variant shows compact icon-and-title tiles.
contentPattern: One row per card: [icon picture plus optional mobile picture] [h3 heading containing the link] [description paragraph]. Trailing CTA row: [link paragraph]. Icons variant: one row per tile: [icon picture] [link title paragraph], plus a CTA row with only a link paragraph.
usage: Use it to showcase insurance products as clickable tiles linking to their pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for linked product or category tiles; pick feature-grid for non-linked icon features or cards for editorial content.
